design.user_request: 只使用 file_creator 工具，不要执行任何 shell 命令。在工作目录创建两个文件：C:\Users\tortl\AppData\Local\Temp\pytest-of-tortl\pytest-222\verify_p1_workdir0\a.txt 内容 hello，C:\Users\tortl\AppData\Local\Temp\pytest-of-tortl\pytest-222\verify_p1_workdir0\b.txt 内容 world

interactions: file_creator invokes file system interface to create files
workspace directory manager resolves relative paths to absolute paths
file content handler writes specified content to created files
file_creator manages directory structure creation for nested paths

required_tools.limitations: Relative paths are resolved based on workspace root directory; absolute Windows paths may require proper normalization
required_tools.impact: critical - primary tool for task execution

risks: Path normalization: Windows absolute paths with backslashes may need proper escaping or normalization
Directory creation: Parent directories may not exist; file_creator must handle nested directory creation
Permission issues: Write permissions required for the temp directory location
Path length: Windows MAX_PATH limitations (260 characters) on older systems; provided path is within limits
